title: Business Pipeline Handbook Integration
brief: Wire handbook maintenance and parts intelligence into QuoteToShipOrchestratorEngine and CapacityPlanningEngine. Factor maintenance costs into machine hourly rates, use capability data for intelligent job routing, and include consumable costs in job cost estimation.

units.title: Wire HandbookMaintenanceIntelligenceEngine into machine rate calculations: factor PM labor, consumable costs, and parts replacement into hourly burden rate per machine
Wire machine capability data into QuoteToShipOrchestratorEngine job routing: use handbook-sourced work envelope, spindle power, and axis count to match jobs to capable machines
Build cost comparison tests: verify that handbook-sourced machine rates reflect real maintenance burden within 15% of actual shop costs for sample machines

exit_conditions: Machine hourly rates include handbook-sourced maintenance burden for machines with ingested handbooks
Job routing considers handbook-documented machine capabilities when selecting candidate machines
Cost comparison tests show handbook-sourced rates are within 15% of actual shop maintenance costs
